name: when-the-network-goes-dark-data
title: When the Network Goes Dark: Gulf Coast cell-site outages in hurricanes, 2017-2026 (data and code)
description: County-by-report panel of FCC Disaster Information Reporting System (DIRS) cell-site outages for 21 Atlantic hurricanes and tropical storms in ten Gulf and Southeast states, 2017-2026, checked against each report's printed totals, with the inputs and code that rebuild it.
spatialCoverage: Texas, Louisiana, Mississippi, Alabama, Florida, Georgia, South Carolina, North Carolina, Tennessee, Virginia (United States), county level

resources.name: dirs_county_day
resources.title: FCC DIRS cell-site outages by county and report
resources.description: One row per county per FCC DIRS report in use (167 reports, 21 storms).

fields.name: storm_key
fields.description: Storm key: NHC ID and DIRS activation date, joined by an underscore.
fields.limitations: Names repeat across years (Isaias 2020 and 2026); always join on this key, not the name.

fields.name: nhc_id
fields.description: National Hurricane Center storm ID (basin, number, year).

fields.name: storm
fields.description: Storm name.
fields.limitations: Not unique across years.

fields.name: dirs_activation_date
fields.description: Date the FCC activated DIRS for the storm.

fields.name: rule_period
fields.description: FCC rule period by activation date. P0: Voluntary DIRS, voluntary Framework (2016-01-01 to 2024-04-30); P1: MDRI in force, DIRS voluntary (2024-05-01 to 2025-02-19); P2: MDRI + mandatory DIRS (2025-02-20 to 2026-06-29); P3: Streamlined DIRS (FCC 26-34) (2026-06-30 to present).
fields.limitations: Descriptive grouping only; periods differ in storms, hazards and filers.

fields.name: doc_id
fields.description: FCC EDOCS document number of the report.

fields.name: report_date
fields.description: Date of the report.

fields.name: as_of_utc
fields.description: The report's stated as-of time, in UTC.
fields.limitations: Where the report prints none, set to 12:00 Eastern on the report date (as_of_imputed).

fields.name: as_of_imputed
fields.description: True when as_of_utc was set to 12:00 Eastern because the report prints no time.

fields.name: report_status
fields.description: Validation status of the report (step 4): ok, flagged (a check raised a note) or known_fcc_inconsistency (a stated total the FCC's own rows do not sum to, listed in code/manifest/known_fcc_inconsistencies.csv).
fields.limitations: Excluded reports are not in the file.

fields.name: state
fields.description: State, as printed.
fields.limitations: Ten study states only.

fields.name: county
fields.description: County as printed by the FCC (upper case).
fields.limitations: Spellings vary between reports; use fips.

fields.name: fips
fields.description: Five-digit county FIPS code (with leading zero).
fields.limitations: Mapped from the printed name with code/manifest/fips_exceptions.csv.

fields.name: sites_served
fields.description: Cell sites served in the county, as reported.
fields.limitations: The denominator differs by storm and report; compare percentages with care. Cell sites as reported by providers to the FCC; a site out is not a count of people without service (the FCC's caveat).

fields.name: sites_out
fields.description: Cell sites out of service in the county, as reported.
fields.limitations: Cell sites as reported by providers to the FCC; a site out is not a count of people without service (the FCC's caveat).

fields.name: pct_out
fields.description: Percent of sites out, as printed (computed from the two counts where not printed).
fields.limitations: Where pct_printed is false the value is computed, not printed.

fields.name: pct_printed
fields.description: True when the report printed the percent column.

fields.name: out_damage
fields.description: Sites out due to damage, as reported.
fields.limitations: Blank where the report has no cause columns. Causes can overlap (see out_overattributed).

fields.name: out_transport
fields.description: Sites out due to transport (backhaul), as reported.
fields.limitations: Blank where the report has no cause columns.

fields.name: out_power
fields.description: Sites out due to power, as reported.
fields.limitations: Blank where the report has no cause columns.

fields.name: on_backup_power
fields.description: Sites operating on backup power, as reported.
fields.limitations: Blank where the report has no such column. Not a measure of sites about to fail.

fields.name: out_unattributed
fields.description: Sites out with no cause given: sites_out minus the three causes, never below 0.
fields.limitations: Blank where the report has no cause columns. Kept apart from out_overattributed; never net them.

fields.name: out_overattributed
fields.description: Causes in excess of sites out (sites counted under more than one cause).
fields.limitations: Blank where the report has no cause columns. May print as -0.0, which equals 0.

fields.name: area_status
fields.description: Whether the county is in the FCC's notice area on the report date: inside, inside_spelling_variant, outside_notice_area or table_not_in_list.
fields.limitations: From the FCC's notices (code/manifest/reporting_areas.csv).

fields.name: fema_declared
fields.description: True if OpenFEMA lists a declaration for the storm covering the county.
fields.limitations: Context for reuse only; no result uses it. This product uses the Federal Emergency Management Agency's OpenFEMA API, but is not endorsed by FEMA.

fields.name: time_flag
fields.description: Blank, or pre_onset_likely_marco for Laura's Aug 25, 2020 report (the FCC's combined Marco and Laura report), which is kept but left out of every time-based result.

resources.name: storms
resources.title: Storm table
resources.description: One row per storm with a DIRS activation in scope, including storms with no usable report.

fields.name: nhc_id
fields.description: National Hurricane Center storm ID.

fields.name: dirs_activation_date
fields.description: Date the FCC activated DIRS.

fields.name: storm_key
fields.description: NHC ID and DIRS activation date.

fields.name: storm
fields.description: Storm name.
fields.limitations: Not unique across years.

fields.name: rule_period
fields.description: FCC rule period by activation date. P0: Voluntary DIRS, voluntary Framework (2016-01-01 to 2024-04-30); P1: MDRI in force, DIRS voluntary (2024-05-01 to 2025-02-19); P2: MDRI + mandatory DIRS (2025-02-20 to 2026-06-29); P3: Streamlined DIRS (FCC 26-34) (2026-06-30 to present).
fields.limitations: Blank for storms not in the panel.

fields.name: landfall_utc
fields.description: Day 0: the first time the storm's 34-kt wind radii reach a study-state county (fallback: first study-state landfall at tropical-storm strength or above).
fields.limitations: Defined from NHC best-track radii; see docs/decisions.md (2026-11-23).

fields.name: landfall_source
fields.description: Which rule set day 0.

fields.name: previous_landfall_utc
fields.description: Day 0 under the original rule (kept for chapter 8's comparison).
fields.limitations: Superseded; not used for the main results.

fields.name: interim_landfall_utc
fields.description: Day 0 under the first 2026-11-23 rule (kept for comparison).
fields.limitations: Superseded; not used for the main results.

fields.name: n_reports
fields.description: Reports in the panel.
fields.limitations: Blank for storms not in the panel.

fields.name: n_counties
fields.description: Counties in the panel.
fields.limitations: Blank for storms not in the panel.

fields.name: first_report
fields.description: First report date in the panel.

fields.name: last_report
fields.description: Last report date in the panel.
fields.limitations: The FCC's last public report, not the end of outages.

fields.name: excluded_reports
fields.description: Reports left out, with date and reason.

fields.name: in_panel
fields.description: True if the storm has at least one report in the panel.

resources.name: bdc_county_provider_counts
resources.title: Broadband provider counts by county and BDC release (counts only)
resources.description: Derived from FCC Broadband Data Collection public data; no provider is named or identified.

fields.name: release
fields.description: FCC Broadband Data Collection release (as-of date).

fields.name: fips
fields.description: Five-digit county FIPS code.
fields.limitations: Study-state counties only.

fields.name: mobile_half
fields.description: Mobile broadband providers reporting coverage of at least half of the county.
fields.limitations: Reported coverage, not which networks were out; providers are never named.

fields.name: mobile_any
fields.description: Mobile broadband providers reporting any coverage in the county.
fields.limitations: Reported coverage, not which networks were out.

fields.name: fixed_any_excl_near_universal
fields.description: Fixed providers with any residential service, near-universal providers excluded.
fields.limitations: Near-universal: service in at least 95% of study-state counties.

fields.name: fixed_any
fields.description: Fixed providers with any residential service.
fields.limitations: Includes near-universal (likely satellite or national fixed-wireless) providers.

fields.name: fixed_half
fields.description: Fixed providers serving at least half of residential locations.

fields.name: fixed_half_excl_near_universal
fields.description: As fixed_half, near-universal providers excluded.

resources.name: results
resources.title: Every number on the page
resources.description: Chapter results with intervals, n and method, written by code/src/10_analysis.py (chapters 1-9) and 12_v2_analysis.py (chapters 10-13).
